experiment: T1 pilot — throughput and object check for the classifier lower side at M>1
finding: the M=2 lower side DOES bind: median eps_lo 0.568 at width 1024 vs 0.392 at width 32, all 12 pilot pairs above the 0.05 lower gate. Direction is favourable — a finer symbol alphabet raises the classifier lower bound, consistent with X8 (the finer object carries more distinguishability). n=12 pairs is a pilot, not the full-990 result.
object: packed k-prefix SYMBOL law at k=5 over the a-priori-fixed categorical alphabet (2M)^k, one-hot rows; the symbol-map construction that produced the published M=1 eps_lo (median 0.534945), NOT the four-marginal 32-vector object
